summary: Upgrade CI actions to Node 24 releases

delivery.outcome: Twin-owned checkout and Python setup steps use immutable Node 24 action releases without changing CI or governance behavior
nonGoals: No change to workflow events, permissions, job names, scripts, shell commands or Python version
No change to the pinned reusable wellmanifest/new-project governance package
No application, protobuf, profile, public interface, dependency, persistent data or secret change

architecture.decision: Retain the existing twin-ci topology and exact inputs while replacing only immutable GitHub Action revisions with their published Node 24 successors
architecture.rollback: Revert the single workflow implementation commit; no application or persistent data migration exists

validation.evidence: Every twin-owned checkout occurrence resolves to the declared Node 24 exact commit
Every twin-owned setup-python occurrence resolves to the declared Node 24 exact commit
The implementation diff changes only action revision tokens
Host, networkless Docker and bounded governance checks pass

commands: Verify protected push and pull-request jobs and their annotations on the published exact head
validation.evidence: Hosted twin-owned jobs pass without their previous Node 20 deprecation annotations
